subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate homophone to fill in the blank.

While learning to drive, Shivani met with an accident because she couldn't hit the ______________.
solution:
The correct answer is '**brake**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**brake**" refers to a device for slowing or stopping a moving vehicle, typically by applying pressure to the wheels. (ब्रेक)
 
• In the context of the sentence, Shivani couldn't hit the "brake" (the vehicle's stopping mechanism), which led to the accident.
 
• The other options: "**break**," "**brick**," and "**brack**" do not fit the context or are incorrect spellings.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *While learning to drive, Shivani met with an accident because she couldn't hit the brake__.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Break (तोड़ना)**: means to separate into pieces as a result of a blow, shock, or strain.
 
• **Brick (ईंट)**: refers to a small rectangular block typically made of fired or sun-dried clay, used in building.
 
• **Brack**: is not a valid word in this context.
